category:music.name: Monochrome (Tidal-compatible)
category:music.author: community
category:music.description: Credentialless Tidal search and playback via Lucida/QQDL and Monochrome cluster with browser UA headers, endpoint rotation, and preview-aware tier failover.

category:music.name: Qobuz Official API
category:music.author: community
category:music.description: Credential-driven Qobuz adapter. Requires qobuzApiBase, qobuzAppId, and qobuzUserAuthToken to be configured via a private host or gateway.

category:music.name: Tidal FLAC (tracks.monochrome.st)
category:music.author: community
category:music.description: Credentialless Tidal FLAC search and playback via tracks.monochrome.st, with per-host failover, a 4-byte fLaC signature check before any rendition is claimed, and retry on the CDN 520s this upstream returns intermittently. Replaces monochrome-tidal, whose eight hosts are all dead or auth-broken.
